sql: SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.name FROM cities AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.city_id WHERE T1.name = 'Khamis Mushait' AND T2.role = 'sales_rep'

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01'

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.id = r.order_item_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.order_date,1,7) = substr(o.order_date,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY (rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ct ON ct.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ct.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province'

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN order_counts oc ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id WHERE ca.avg_hours > (SELECT avg_hours FROM overall)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01')

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h1_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h1_2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' AND NOT (o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01') GROUP BY r.id, r.name HAVING h1_2024 > 0) SELECT region_name FROM rev ORDER BY (h1_2025 - h1_2024) / h1_2024 ASC, region_name LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 2 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(t.closed_at) - julianday(t.opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT r.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01') OR (o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01')) GROUP BY r.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY (rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY (rev.revenue - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH item_rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, oi.id AS item_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01'), item_ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(ir.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM item_rev ir JOIN employees e ON e.id = ir.employee_id LEFT JOIN item_ref rf ON rf.order_item_id = ir.item_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT r.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END)) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1
